mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and overall economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and economic growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals increased consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5% and CPI inflation is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases, the combination signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP over two quarters signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained increase over two quarters.
